messages:
Priya: Marigold Health reporting P1 — intermittent 503s on dedicated pool in us-west-2 since ~08:10 PDT. Error rate ~6%, spikes at p99. Need immediate owners, short-term workaround, and ETA for a fix. Logs attached by customer: `curl -v https://api.marigold.health -> 503`
Sam: I'm taking ownership for triage. Started pulling traces and tail logs. @Olivia can you check autoscaler events and any recent node churn?
Olivia: looking now — I see repeated scale-ups then immediate scale-downs between 08:08–08:12. Several nodes reported oom_kill on inference-worker. Hostnames: pool3-worker-*-usw2. Suspect memory pressure + aggressive scale policy.
Henry: pinged infra — kernel OOM pattern. There's a known kernel bug on current AMI that can trigger under high mmap usage. I can hotpatch a kernel parameter and drain/recreate nodes in that pool. Rolling patch estimated ~20–25m for pool-3 in us-west-2. ETA ~09:05 PDT if we start now.
Priya: ok, we need a short-term network/routing mitigation so customer sees less disruption. @Mike can you put a routing policy in to route Marigold traffic to hosted fallback (lower-capacity model) for 20% of requests and cap concurrency? Also add a temporary retry/backoff on 5xx.
Mike: will do. Applying routing change now: `infra-router set-route --team marigold --fallback hosted-small --traffic 20% --concurrency 60` -> deploy started.
deploy-bot: infra-router change started by Mike at 08:22 PDT. Rolling out to us-west-2.
deploy-bot: infra-router change succeeded (all shards) at 08:24 PDT.
Olivia: after routing change, observed 503 rate dropped from ~6% -> ~0.9% within 2m. p95 latency improved; p99 still elevated (~1.5s -> 1.2s). OOM events stopped on the replaced nodes.
Priya: good improvement. Henry, please proceed with the kernel parameter hotpatch on pool-3. Ensure canary on 2 nodes first. Communicate if any additional customer impact expected.
Henry: starting canary patch now on pool3-worker-canary-1/2. If canary healthy for 5m, I'll proceed full roll.
Sam: I'm opening a diagnostic PR with logs, flame graphs, and proposed scaling policy changes (reduce scale-down aggressiveness, increase mem headroom). PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/+/PR-4823 assigned to Henry and Olivia.
Nina-CS: Customer Success here — I'll update Marigold's ops contact: note that we routed 20% traffic to fallback and are rolling a host patch; ETA for full fix ~25m. Asking if they want a maintenance window for more invasive work.
Priya: assign postmortem owner: Henry for root cause and fix; Olivia for monitoring/playbook updates; Sam to follow up on autoscale policy. Nina-CS will collect customer timeline & acceptance.
Olivia: can confirm canary nodes healthy after 7m. No OOMs, traffic steady. Proceeding with phased rollout.
Henry: full roll complete at 08:47 PDT. Pool-3 nodes recreated on patched AMI, no further OOMs observed.
Sam: monitoring shows 503s ~0.1% now and stable, p99 back to baseline. Leaving routing fallback for 60m before removing to be safe.
Priya: thanks team. Next steps: Sam will update the PR with metrics and revert candidate; Henry will file infra bug and track patch to AMI bake; Olivia will update the runbook to include scale-down thresholds; Nina-CS will send the customer update. We'll reconvene asynchronously here and in #incident-ops if anything regresses. :thumbsup:
